# Sprout

> Sprout is an offline-first habit and wellness app that turns small, consistent
> daily actions into lasting change. It tracks habits, builds timezone-safe streaks,
> shows honest analytics, supports goals and routines, and includes a calming
> meditation timer. It works fully offline and requires no account or sign-up.

## Key facts
- Category: Habit tracker / wellness / productivity app
- Platforms: iOS and Android (coming soon)
- Price: Free forever core app; optional Premium at $3.99/month
- Privacy: Offline-first, data stored locally on device, no ads, no trackers, no data selling
- Account: Not required — fully usable as a guest; an account is only needed for optional cloud sync and community

## Core features
- Real streaks: computed in calendar-day space and stored in UTC, so travel and daylight saving never break progress
- Honest analytics: completion rates, weekly consistency and trend charts derived only from real, stored check-ins
- Goals & routines: measurable goals and morning/evening habit chains
- Meditation timer: distraction-free timer with recorded sessions
- Achievements: milestones earned from genuine effort, never fabricated
- Smart reminders: on-device reminders that fire on time, offline, across time zones and DST

## Premium ($3.99/month)
Everything in Free, plus advanced analytics & insights, unlimited goals & routines,
cloud sync, community access, and premium themes. Billed via the app store.
